starter:
-- Urgent tickets with a readable state
SELECT
  ticket_id,
  CASE
    WHEN closed_at = NULL THEN 'open'
    WHEN satisfaction = NULL THEN 'unrated'
    WHEN satisfaction <= 2 THEN 'unhappy'
    ELSE 'happy'
  END AS state
FROM support_tickets
WHERE priority = 'urgent'
ORDER BY ticket_id;
solution:
SELECT
  ticket_id,
  CASE
    WHEN closed_at IS NULL THEN 'open'
    WHEN satisfaction IS NULL THEN 'unrated'
    WHEN satisfaction <= 2 THEN 'unhappy'
    ELSE 'happy'
  END AS state
FROM support_tickets
WHERE priority = 'urgent'
ORDER BY ticket_id;
